versions.changelog:
Initial release of dappier-search skill.

- Provides fast, free real-time web search and premium data from trusted media brands (news, finance, sports, entertainment, weather, and more).
- Includes dedicated tools for real-time search, stock market data (with ticker symbols), sports news, Benzinga financial news, lifestyle news, research papers, and solar/roof analysis.
- Requires a DAPPIER_API_KEY for access.
- Designed to build powerful AI agents with versatile data access and search capabilities.
